classHousingNote: Class buildings house followers of matching NPC classes like a Bunkhouse (cap 2, +1 per upgrade); residents get +15% output.
_rankNote: Non-manor buildings: rankSlots[upgrade level] = extra furniture slots; structure.unlockUp[item] = upgrade level needed to place it

village._note: Personal village (Era 3): founded by the Baron's charter (a resource request quest: Valley deed + Dynasty phase, deliver coin/blocks/planks). Village buildings use village slots (production buildings take 2), make outMult× output with jobMult× follower spots, cost coinMult× the estate coin + matMult× its materials, and pay upkeep of their coin price each month. Each village building is a construction project: deliver its price in parts, one project at a time; Auto Deliver feeds it from surplus (coin above autoCoin, materials above their keep-in-reserve setting).

stoneRanks._note: Stone ranks: stone/blocks are Sandstone (old saves keep them). Limestone from a Deep Quarry or Thornwick, granite from Quarry Works or the Eyrie, marble only from the Eyrie market. The Mason's Table cuts each into its own blocks. Village tier-1/2 buildings and village growth need limestone/granite blocks; fine buildings (Hall, manor line, Ancestor Hall) need marble blocks.

chores._note: R42 chore tiers: chores live in activities.json with chore.opens (all must hold: stage, structure, village). Free basic auto runs every open chore at autoRate when nobody works it by hand. DLC adds chores by adding entries.
